caseNameFull: Doyle v. Ohio and Wood v. Ohio

opinions.text: Ct. App. Ohio, Tus-carawas County. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 823.] Motion to permit Ronald L. Collins, Esquire, to present oral argument pro hac vice on behalf of respondent in both cases granted. Applications for stay of execution and enforcement of judgments and/or bail (Nos. A-94 and A-96), presented to Mr. Justice Stewart, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
